marine.title: Forecast for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Wind southeast 25 knots diminishing to south 15 early this
afternoon then increasing to southwest 25 early this evening. Wind increasing to
northwest 35 Thursday morning then diminishing to northwest 25 near noon
Thursday. Snow this morning and tonight and Thursday morning changing
to flurries Thursday morning. Visibility 1 mile or less in
snow. Temperatures minus 2 rising to plus 3 this afternoon then
falling to minus 2 Thursday morning. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Thursday.
marine.text:
Seas 1 metre building to 2 early this morning then subsiding to 1
this afternoon. Seas building to 2 to 3 late overnight.<br/>
